info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Gateway Management API
info.description: The Operational Gateway Management API enables users to modify configurations associated with operational gateways within the banking IT infrastructure. Through this endpoint, developers can manage settings, update statuses, and ensure optimal functionality of the operational gateways. This API is primarily designed for IT administrators and DevOps teams involved in maintaining and enhancing banking systems. Typical use cases include adjusting operational parameters and responding to performance metrics.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the operational gateway identified by the specified resource ID (RES-100045). You can modify various attributes of this resource to ensure it reflects the desired state of your operational gateway.

requestBody.description: Updates the operational gateway configuration for the specified resource. The request requires a JSON object which includes the necessary fields to modify the gateway's operational parameters. Please ensure that the JSON structure follows the defined schema to avoid validation errors.
